class.name: CSV
class.brief_description: Reads and writes CSV text as arrays, and list resources as CSV.

method.name: append_row
method.description: Adds [param values] as a new row at the end. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: append_typed_row
method.description: Adds a row from typed [param values], keyed by the column names of [member header] (by the field names of [param schema] in order if there is no header). Numbers, booleans and strings are written plainly, other types with [method @GlobalScope.var_to_str]. A missing key writes the field's [member DataField.default_value]. Returns [constant ERR_INVALID_DATA] and adds nothing if a value does not convert to the type of its field.

method.name: deserialize
method.description: Creates a list [Resource] of the class [param type_hint] from CSV [param text]: every row becomes one element of its typed array of resources. CSV has no type marker, so [param type_hint] is needed. Returns [code]null[/code] and prints an error if the text can't be read. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.deserialize(text, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_CSV, type_hint, options)[/code].

method.name: find_column
method.description: Returns the index of the column named [param name] in [member header], or [code]-1[/code] if there is no such column.

method.name: find_rows
method.description: Returns the indices of all rows whose cell in [param column] equals [param value].

method.name: get_cell
method.description: Returns the cell at [param row] and [param column], or an empty [String] if the row is shorter than [param column]. Prints an error if [param row] is out of range.

method.name: get_cells
method.description: Returns a block of [param row_count] rows and [param column_count] columns starting at [param row] and [param column], as an [Array] of [PackedStringArray]. Rows past the last row are left out; cells missing in a row are empty strings. With [method stringify] and a tab delimiter, the block becomes text that spreadsheets paste.

method.name: get_column
method.description: Returns the cells of [param column] in all rows. Rows that are shorter give an empty [String].

method.name: get_column_count
method.description: Returns the number of columns: the larger of the size of [member header] and the length of the longest row.

method.name: get_row
method.description: Returns the cells of the row at index [param row]. Prints an error and returns an empty array if [param row] is out of range.

method.name: get_row_as_dictionary
method.description: Returns the row at index [param row] as a [Dictionary] keyed by the column names of [member header]. Prints an error if [member header] is empty or [param row] is out of range.

method.name: get_row_count
method.description: Returns the number of data rows, not counting the header.

method.name: get_typed_column
method.description: Returns the cells of [param column] converted to the type of its field in [param schema]: a [PackedInt64Array] for [int], [PackedFloat64Array] for [float], [PackedStringArray] for strings, [PackedVector2Array], [PackedVector3Array], [PackedVector4Array] or [PackedColorArray] for those types, an [Array] for other types. Empty and unconvertible cells give the field's [member DataField.default_value] (0 in packed number arrays).

method.name: get_typed_row
method.description: Returns the row at index [param row] as a [Dictionary] of typed values, keyed by the column names of [member header] (by field name, or column index, if there is no header). Each cell is converted to the type of its field in [param schema] (by header name, or by position without a header); empty and unconvertible cells give the field's [member DataField.default_value], cells without a field stay strings.

method.name: insert_column
method.description:
Inserts a column at index [param column] (from [code]0[/code] to [method get_column_count]); the following columns move right. [param name] goes into [member header] if the CSV has a header or [param name] is not empty, and every row gets [param value] in the new column. Emits [signal Resource.changed] once and drops the kept parsed text. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var csv = CSV.new() csv.parse("id,name
1,Ann
") csv.insert_column(1, "team", "red") print(csv.encode_to_text()) # Prints "id,team,name
1,red,Ann
" [/gdscript] [csharp] var csv = new Csv(); csv.Parse("id,name
1,Ann
"); csv.InsertColumn(1, "team", "red"); GD.Print(csv.EncodeToText()); // Prints "id,team,name
1,red,Ann
" [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: insert_row
method.description: Inserts [param values] as a new row at index [param row]; the following rows move down. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: parse_string
method.description: Parses the CSV [param text] and returns its rows, like [method TextDataFormat.parse]. Returns an empty [Array] and prints the error if the text can't be read.

method.name: remove_column
method.description: Removes the column at index [param column] (below [method get_column_count]) from [member header] and from every row; the following columns move left. Emits [signal Resource.changed] once and drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: remove_row
method.description: Removes the row at index [param row]. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: serialize
method.description: Returns a list [param resource] as CSV text: the resource needs exactly one typed array of resources with simple properties, and every element becomes one row. Use [method ResourceTextSerializer.can_serialize] to check a resource first. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if the resource can't be written. The same as [code]ResourceTextSerializer.serialize(resource, ResourceTextSerializer.FORMAT_CSV, options)[/code].

method.name: set_cell
method.description: Sets the cell at [param row] and [param column] to [param value]. A row that is shorter is padded with empty cells. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: set_cells
method.description: Writes a block of cells (an [Array] of [PackedStringArray], one per row) with its first cell at [param row] and [param column]. Rows past the last row are appended, short rows are extended. [param row] may be [method get_row_count] to append the block. Emits [signal Resource.changed] once for the whole block. Paste tab-separated text copied from a spreadsheet: [codeblocks] [gdscript] var options = SerializerOptions.new() options.csv_delimiter = "\t" options.csv_headers = false csv.set_cells(0, 1, CSV.parse_string(DisplayServer.clipboard_get(), options)) [/gdscript] [csharp] var options = new SerializerOptions { CsvDelimiter = "\t", CsvHeaders = false }; csv.SetCells(0, 1, Csv.ParseString(DisplayServer.ClipboardGet(), options)); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: set_row
method.description: Replaces the row at index [param row] with [param values]. Drops the kept parsed text.

method.name: stringify
method.description: Writes the rows in [param data] as CSV text. Rows are either all [Dictionary]s or all arrays ([Array] or [PackedStringArray]). For dictionaries, the columns are the keys in order of first appearance (sorted with [member SerializerOptions.sort_keys]), a header row is written unless [member SerializerOptions.csv_headers] is off, and a missing key is an empty cell. Values are converted with [method @GlobalScope.str], [code]null[/code] is an empty cell. Returns an empty [String] and prints an error if a row has another type.

method.name: validate_translation

members.member: The names of the columns. Filled by [method TextDataFormat.parse] only if [member SerializerOptions.csv_headers] is on; empty otherwise. [method find_column] and [method get_row_as_dictionary] use it, and it is written as the first line, with unnamed columns added for rows that are wider, so the text parses again. Changing it drops the kept parsed text.
